messages:
tori_sales: MerchantX confirmed they're ready to evaluate a drop-in replacement for CompetitorY. They want a short POC: dual-run for parity, security sign-off, and a clear estimate on billing impact. Proposed window: Jun 6-10.

jamal_se: I'll own parity tests and token-estimates. Need their canonical prompt set + a handful of failure cases. Fast checklist: prompt normalization (newline/stop), sampling params, and response schema differences.

sam_infra: I'll own the canary proxy. Plan: dual-call mode (send to both endpoints), store side-by-side, and enable 1% traffic mirror first. Need static egress IPs for MerchantX allowlist and a CNAME for health checks.

lisa_security: On security: MerchantX requires a short questionnaire, SSO integration (SAML), and confirmation of encryption + access controls. For KMS, hosted can support customer-managed keys in Dedicated/Private. I'll upload the questionnaire by EOD.

ophelia_support: I'll assemble the eval harness. Can accept prompts in CSV or JSONL. ETA to wire harness once we have prompts: 2 business days. Also will add metrics: semantic-drift score, token delta, and latency percentiles.

jamal_se: Note a behavior drift to watch: CompetitorY strips trailing whitespace and applies a default stop. Make sure tests set explicit stop tokens to match. Also watch default sampling: their default top_p=1.0 vs our default top_p=0.95 can change output length.

tori_sales: Buyer asked about pricing model mapping—CompetitorY bills per-response-chunk. Can we produce an estimated compare sheet?

jamal_se: Yes. I'll tokenize their 50 canonical prompts and run sample responses to estimate avg tokens/request and cost delta at our hosted rates. Will include options: enable caching prefixes, reduce sampling to lower tokens, and batching effects.

sam_infra: Infra note: If MerchantX wants 99.9% SLA and static capacity, recommend Dedicated reservation for the POC window to avoid noisy neighbor risk. Also produce a rollback plan to route back in <5min.

lisa_security: Legal/safety flags: data residency (they want EU-only), audit logs retention, and SOC2. We have SOC2; for EU-only data path we need Private or Dedicated in eu-west. I'll confirm with infra.

jamal_se: For the canary diffs, we'll run: 1) surface-level JSON diff, 2) semantic similarity score (embedding cosine), and 3) token delta report. I'll produce a small report template.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created ticket SELL-1127 for MerchantX POC coordination. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/SELL-1127

ophelia_support: MerchantX committed to deliver prompts tomorrow and will share a 24h sample of traffic. Once received, I'll queue them into the harness and run a quick smoke.

tori_sales: Action items: jamal_se -> parity harness + token estimates (due 1718170000). sam_infra -> canary proxy + static IPs + rollback play (due 1718050000). lisa_security -> questionnaire + EU-data path confirmation (due 1718012000). ophelia_support -> prep harness and run smoke after prompt receipt. Weekly sync Fri 9am PT. Ping #release-war-room for blockers. :thumbsup:
